Inside a hidden step, a point within the step is offered only if it takes back none of the other player's hidden actions there (their public ones, such as finishing planning or deployment, may be taken back); the start of the step may take back the other player's hidden actions too. The actions taken back are removed from the game, as if they had not been taken.
